item.title: AI model releases: 19–25 October 2026
item.description: A completed-week review, updated through the Kimi and MiniMax notes published on 26 October. New APIs, public weights, specialist models, and the price and access changes that affect a deployment.

item.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: public weights with commercial-use conditions
item.description: The downloadable checkpoint uses MiniMax’s custom Community License, with attribution, notice and a separate authorization requirement above a stated revenue threshold.
